نلهاج (form XI)
# نَلْهَاجُّ (nalhājju) /nal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# نَلْهَاجَّ (nalhājja) /nal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# نَلْهَاجِّ (nalhājji) /nal.haːd͡ʒ.d͡ʒi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
